SOC Tier 2 Methodology.description: SOC Tier 2 analyst playbook — deep investigation, containment, and incident management.

steps.task: Review full Tier 1 analysis and all attached IOCs
Confirm true positive — reproduce or independently validate
Assign incident severity (P1-P4) and classify incident type (intrusion/malware/data breach/etc.)
Open formal incident record in ITSM/IR platform
Notify stakeholders per severity SLA — manager, IR lead, CISO (P1/P2)
Map the full attack timeline — earliest artifact back to present
Identify patient zero — first compromised asset/account
Determine initial access vector — phishing, exposed service, insider, supply chain
Trace lateral movement — what systems did the attacker reach?
Identify all compromised accounts — reset scope beyond initial alert
Determine attacker objective — ransomware, exfil, espionage, destruction
MITRE ATT&CK mapping — map observed TTPs to framework
Check for data exfiltration — unusual outbound connections, large transfers, DLP alerts
Collect memory dump from compromised host (if required and possible)
Acquire disk image or triage collection (Velociraptor, KAPE)
Export relevant SIEM logs for the incident timeframe
Preserve firewall, proxy, DNS logs for the incident window
Document chain of custody for all evidence collected
Extract and submit all IOCs — hashes, IPs, domains, registry keys, mutexes
Isolate compromised host — network block or EDR isolation (preserve for forensics)
Disable / reset compromised user accounts
Revoke active sessions and OAuth tokens for compromised accounts
Block attacker C2 domains/IPs at firewall, proxy, and DNS layer
Identify and block all attacker-controlled accounts or backdoors
Enable enhanced logging on affected systems
Remove all malware, backdoors, and persistence mechanisms found
Patch or mitigate exploited vulnerability
Verify no additional persistence exists (scheduled tasks, reg keys, services, cron)
Reset all potentially compromised credentials (not just confirmed)
Scan environment for lateral spread using all identified IOCs
Restore from clean backup or rebuild affected systems
Verify system integrity before reconnecting to network
Monitor recovered systems closely for 48-72 hours post-recovery
Write incident report — timeline, impact, root cause, actions taken
Conduct post-incident review — what detection gaps existed?
Update SIEM rules and detection content based on incident TTPs
Share IOCs with threat intel platform and relevant ISACs
